entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It's been a while since I've come to[n]a place like this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sorry for dragging you along.
It's a nice place.[clr 27]
Why me?
Could bring a girl here...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm glad you like it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This suits you, huh? I wasn't sure if[n]you were the type.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose because you seemed bored.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No, I'm mostly kidding.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose it is rather famous as a[n]good place for dates.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'd never have guessed you were such[n]a romantic, though.

entries.speaker: Familiar Voice
entries.en: Oh?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I thought I recognized those glasses![n]Look who it is!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And we even got the second Detective[n]Prince here, too—

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: W-Wait, what!?
Keep it quiet, please...
Why are you here?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, sorry...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Uh, I'm just here for material on a[n]fluff piece. Date spots for kids these[n]days, that kinda thing.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But that's not important! Why are you[n]with Akechi-kun?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I invited him out. We're fairly close,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You are, huh...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, uh... Don't mind me. I'm just a[n]reporter.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: He helps me with my articles[n]sometimes.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: But who would have guessed you were[n]friends with the famous teen detective?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: And unlike you, he's pretty hardline[n]anti-Phantom-Thieves, right? Mind if I[n]ask a couple questions about you two?
If you like.[clr 27]
That's kind of personal.
What's it worth to you?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, you're down? I was just kidding.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm no model journalist, but I'm not[n]dumb enough to pry into a high[n]schooler's private life.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Heheh, I was just kidding.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm no model journalist, but I'm not[n]dumb enough to pry into a high[n]schooler's private life.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Oh, we negotiating now? It's cool,[n]I was just kidding.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm no model journalist, but I'm not[n]dumb enough to pry into a high[n]schooler's private life.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I thought this report would be boring,[n]but I got a nice surprise out of it.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, see you next time I need info.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You have some friends in the media,[n]I see.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And if I heard right, you two have some[n]sort of professional agreement?
What of it?[clr 27]
It's nothing bad.[clr 27]
How about these fish, huh?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Nothing. It's just interesting to me how[n]your friends come from all walks of life.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, I wasn't worrying about that.[n]Of course, if you have to explicitly[n]deny it, then...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No, just a joke.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haha, you're just making it seem[n]more suspicious!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm sorry if I'm prying. You truly are[n]interesting.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Thanks for coming out today. We should[n]head home.
